violation_type.title: Training Criteria - Certificate (26 TAC §744.1319(c)(4))
violation_type.typical_finding: As of today, the operation has not submitted training certificates for 1 staff file evaluated.

finding_variants.text: As of today, the operation has not submitted training certificates for 1 staff file evaluated.

2 out of 10 staff files evaluated did not contain training certificate for completion of CPR and First Aid Training.    3 out of 10 staff files evaluated did not contain training certificates that show the full 15 hours of annual training has been completed.
1 out of 4 staff files evaluated did not contain a certificate of completion for Pre-Service Training.    Note The director created the training certificate during the inspection.
Training certificates were missing for 1 staff file evaluated.
1 out of 3 staff files evaluated did not contain the certificate showing CPR and First aid training has been completed.
